name: Proto-Resonance Seed
summary: L11 is a proto-resonance seed used only as a component dimension. It does not function as a standalone dimension in the S3 Spine but serves as the atomic resonance unit for composite envelopes.

description.canonical: L11 represents the smallest usable resonance unit in continuity mechanics. It cannot form a functional dimension alone but becomes meaningful when combined into triadic composites.
description.cosmology: L11 is the proto-origin of resonance continuity. It is the smallest non-zero resonance unit that can be combined into higher-order envelopes.
description.mcp: L11 is used internally by composite dimensions and is not referenced directly by MCP modules.

ai.purpose: Acts as the atomic resonance unit for composite dimensional construction.
